about: Assets you may use in your own videos but must not share as files (licence or privacy). Settings > 'Use assets that can't be shared' turns them on or off for Claude, Codex and the asset browser. They are not in the public asset pack: Mixkit items are re-downloaded from Mixkit by app/tools/fetch_mixkit_assets.py, Sonniss from sonniss.com.

folders.assets/Default assets/Music/: Mixkit music (Mixkit licence: free to use, no re-sharing)
folders.assets/Default assets/Footage/: Mixkit stock footage (Mixkit licence: free to use, no re-sharing)
folders.assets/Default assets/Sound effects/Mixk: Mixkit sound effects (Mixkit licence: free to use, no re-sharing)
folders.assets/Default assets/Sound effects/Sonn: Sonniss GDC bundle (royalty-free use, no re-sharing)
folders.assets/Default assets/Arabic/: Arabic memes and sound bites copied from online videos (copyright of their owners)
folders.assets/Default assets/Icons/Remixicon/: Remix Icon (Remix Icon License: free to use, not to re-share as an icon pack)
